*''This will soon include statistics for members, and will remain alphabetical. This is largely a democracy and anyone wishing to implement new ideas such as "titles" (founder, veteran, rookie, etc) should discuss it in the [[Bloodline Talk:Succession League Policies|Discussion]] page. If you don't like your statistics, they can be Reset. If your statistics REALLY don't like you (stats come from fellow players), then YOU may be Reset(suspended from the League). Only extreme behavior on the level of repetitive vandalism (in game and on here) will warrant this. See [[Succession League Policies|Policies]]
